title: Mobility-support stair evacuation plan
summary: Plan assistance before a lift outage or evacuation so a person with limited mobility is not left to an unsafe improvised carry.
content: Field sequence: Agree on trained helpers, communication, safe waiting area, mobility aids, medical equipment, route width, handover point, and when emergency services must perform the movement.
